longterm.outlook: Johnson was awarded the Sixth Man of the Year while averaging 13.2 PPG and 5.4 RPG in 23.3 minutes per game. He also shot 51.9% from the field while appearing in all 82 games. The concern is playing time after his role shrank during San Antonio’s playoff run, especially with Dylan Harper expected to take on more minutes and Tobias Harris, Julian Champagnie and Carter Bryant competing on the wing. Johnson remains a useful scorer and rebounder, but he’s best viewed as a late round flier in deeper leagues or a waiver-wire option in standard formats.
